title: Special Topics in Sociology; Theories of Nation Building: Israel as a Case Study
description:
Cross-listed with ISRL349J. Credit only granted for ISRL349J or SOCY398V.

The course focuses on nation building; its overt and covert mechanism and various policies and efforts used to make the borders of the state coincide with that of the nation. How various political and ideological groups unite and rally around their nations flag? What are State policies that maintain its cohesion? What are the reasons Garibaldi in Italy or Bismarck in Germany during the 19th century succeeded in transferring small kingdoms into significant 20th century nation states? How Grimm's Fairy Tales influenced the Germans nation building? The process of state building in Israel was accompanied also with nationbuilding. Through focusing on the Israeli process of nation building we will scrutinize other nations state commonalities for nation building. All required readings are posted on Elms.
